dataset_policy: Twelve complete synthetic inputs and semantic expectations were frozen before the parent changed Python production code. Six development and six holdout cases; no model or map provider sends.
before_policy: The benchmark loads time_planner.py, planning_constraints.py and result_policy.py from e0d51a9 into memory. Model schemas and installed dependency versions are recorded separately. It does not claim the whole repository was checked out to that revision.
clock_policy: The synthetic fact clock is fixed at 2026-10-25T00:00:00+00:00 for reproducibility. Fact sources are synthetic and do not verify any actual venue.
oracle_policy: An independent checker evaluates timeline order, positive durations, day bounds, required activity presence, opening windows, time locks/completed slots, route uncertainty disclosure and unchanged days. Frozen expected status/outcome constants evaluate product classifications. The checker never calls production quality functions to grade their own output.
baseline_policy: Travel-order minimizes directed route minutes over exactly the same candidate locations, then attempts earliest legal windows in that order. Window-greedy selects earliest closing feasible nodes with the same facts and directed routes. Mandatory visits are never silently dropped. Infeasible attempts remain visible to the checker. Prior-day state aggregation and intercity access are explicitly not applicable to local route-order baselines.

initial_validator_correction.issue: The first checker required duplicate prose notes on every estimated route leg, stricter than the frozen estimated_routes_disclosed semantic expectation. The current UI uses estimated leg status and whole-day unknown gaps; the final return leg need not repeat identical prose.
initial_validator_correction.correction: Require estimated timeline legs, a whole-day route uncertainty gap and a visible uncertainty note, without requiring duplicate prose on every leg. Normalize both sides identically for baseline outside-scope comparisons. No input or expected result was changed.
initial_validator_correction.comparison_policy: Final before and after reports must contain the same evaluator_sha256. Initial-validator diagnostics are preserved and excluded from before/after effect counts.

interpretation: Targeted regression evidence only. Do not call these ratios model factual accuracy, general itinerary usability, real-user satisfaction, production SLA or provider-cost savings.
